title: React Native
description: Native mobile components with shared tokens and behaviour.
setup: Use minerva-design/native in React Native or Expo. Keep the React version required by your Expo SDK. No web stylesheet is needed; MinervaProvider resolves tokens to native styles. The workspace includes apps/expo-example.
validation: Unit and interaction tests run with React Native Testing Library; browser previews use react-native-web. iOS and Android device validation is still pending.
